title: Traveller
description: A simple, configurable transport plugin for paper/purpur.
body:
# Traveller

A complete teleportation plugin for Purpur and Paper servers. Traveller puts /spawn, /home, /tpa, and /back into one lightweight plugin. You can turn each of these on and off for your own custom experience.

## Commands:
#### Spawn: 
/spawn, /setspawn
#### Homes: 
/home <name>, /sethome <name>, /delhome <name>, /homes
#### TPA: 
/tpa <player>, /tpahere <player>, /tpaccept <player>, /tpdeny <player>, /tpcancel
#### Back: 
/back
#### Admin: 
/traveller <reload|info|version>

## Important configurations:
#### Warmups: 
the seconds the player must stand still before teleporting. The countdown is shown on the action bar, a title, or in chat.
#### Cooldowns: 
the seconds before the same command can be used again.
#### cancel-on-move or cancel-on-damage:
stop the teleportation if the player moves or takes damage.
